title: PBT doesn’t make grokking faster, but it can escape a hyperparameter range where nothing groks [P]
summary: I ran Population Based Training over learning rate and weight decay on grokking (modular addition mod 97, 35% train split, small MLP, 20 members, 20k steps, full batch). Results vs a grid (equal compute, 3 seeds): the best fixed cell reached 95% val acc in 317 ± 29 steps; PBT too
reason: Reddit discussion post describing a self-run PBT/grokking experiment; no peer-reviewed paper, arXiv preprint, or official benchmark release link, so research rule 2-1 is not met. Not a model release, business event, policy action, or OSS tool launch.
